fact: Arabian horses are known for endurance and a distinctive dished face.

Quarter horses are powerful sprinters and versatile ranch horses.
Appaloosas are known for spotted coat patterns and striped hooves.
American Paint Horses have large patches of white and darker color.

Percherons are strong draft horses that originated in France.
Belgian draft horses are among the strongest heavy horse breeds.
Shires are very tall draft horses developed in Britain.

Lipizzaners are famous for classical dressage and often turn gray as they mature.
